title: High cyclomatic complexity: get_vm_create_spec (CCN=15)
detail: `get_vm_create_spec` has a cyclomatic complexity of 15 over 81 lines (L180–289). Functions this complex are hard to test exhaustively, tend to accumulate subtle conditional bugs, and resist refactoring. Suggested fix: extract cohesive sub-operations into smaller, named functions with clear preconditions.

title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1669 lines)
detail: File is 1669 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 2 sites (L1304,L1373)
detail: `except Exception` catches all exceptions without re-raising, swallowing unexpected errors silently. This hides failures and makes the caller unable to distinguish success from silent failure. Suggested fix: catch only the exception types the callee can raise, or use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()` for cleanup handlers.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 14 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L292,L304,L563,L752,L833,L1070)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.
